scope: Read-only observation of the WAN route from the NAS-side gateway

assessment.reason: The router-facing address is private and differs from the observed outbound egress address, so an upstream NAT or outer router exists.

required_before_publication: Obtain a provider-assigned global inbound IPv4 or configure a controlled outer router with a global address
Verify inbound TCP 80 and 443 from an independent external network
Point DNS only to the verified ingress endpoint
limitations: No router, DNS, NAS, firewall or VPS setting was changed
The observation does not determine whether the upstream NAT is provider-managed CGNAT or a user-controlled outer router
No public reachability or IP persistence was demonstrated
